```yaml
name: Release Binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Deno
        uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2
        with:
          deno-version: v1.x

      - name: Compile binaries
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          deno compile --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --output dist/invidious-companion-windows.exe src/index.ts
          deno compile --target x86_64-apple-darwin --output dist/invidious-companion-macos-x86_64 src/index.ts
          deno compile --target aarch64-apple-darwin --output dist/invidious-companion-macos-aarch64 src/index.ts
          deno compile --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/invidious-companion-linux-x86_64 src/index.ts
          deno compile --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu --output dist/invidious-companion-linux-aarch64 src/index.ts

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload Windows binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/invidious-companion-windows.exe
          asset_name: invidious-companion-${{ github.ref_name }}-windows.exe
          asset_content_type: application/vnd.microsoft.portable-executable

      - name: Upload macOS x86_64 binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/invidious-companion-macos-x86_64
          asset_name: invidious-companion-${{ github.ref_name }}-macos-x86_64
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload macOS aarch64 binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/invidious-companion-macos-aarch64
          asset_name: invidious-companion-${{ github.ref_name }}-macos-aarch64
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload Linux x86_64 binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/invidious-companion-linux-x86_64
          asset_name: invidious-companion-${{ github.ref_name }}-linux-x86_64
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream

      - name: Upload Linux aarch64 binary
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.create_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: dist/invidious-companion-linux-aarch64
          asset_name: invidious-companion-${{ github.ref_name }}-linux-aarch64
          asset_content_type: application/octet-stream
```
